items.name: Rime / Weasel (小狼毫) with the rime-cantonese schema
steps: Download the Weasel (小狼毫) installer that includes the Jyutping (粵拼) schema from jyutping.net. Weasel's own README says the Jyutping schema is no longer bundled with its installer.
Run the installer and follow its instructions. On a first install it shows an Install Options dialog.
Press the Windows key + Space and choose 小狼毫輸入法 as your input method.
Select the 中 icon in the input indicator menu to start typing with Weasel.
Press Ctrl+` or F4 to open the schema menu and switch the input mode.
The rime-cantonese schema supports only Jyutping (粵拼), the Linguistic Society of Hong Kong scheme.

sources.says: the Windows installer that includes Jyutping, and the Windows key + Space step
installing Weasel, the 中 icon, Ctrl+` / F4, and that Jyutping is no longer bundled
the schema supports only Jyutping (粵拼)

items.platform: iPhone / iPad, Android (also Windows, macOS, web)
items.name: TypeDuck 打得粵拼輸入法
steps: Open typeduck.hk and choose the download link for your device. It lists Windows, macOS, iPhone/iPad and Android, and a web version.
Follow the installation guide linked on that page for your device. The guides are PDFs, in Chinese and in English.

sources.says: its title calls it a Jyutping input method (打得粵拼輸入法), the platform list and the installation guides
